shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.1: Tap + to add an app; paste a URL to fill in its name and icon.
help.2: Long-press an icon to tidy up, then drag to reorder.
help.3: Tap the × badge to delete; undo within 5 seconds.
help.4: Change wallpaper and light / dark theme in Settings.
help.5: Tap the globe to switch language anytime — text and formats follow.
help.6: Export / import a backup to restore everything on a new device.
